stories.title: 69 killed in high‑speed rail collision south of Madrid
stories.summary: A collision on the high‑speed rail line south of Madrid resulted in 69 bodies being recovered from wreckage on the tracks and an embankment in central Spain. The disaster follows a crash near Córdoba nine months earlier that killed 46 people. A formal investigation into the Toledo crash has just been opened, and the incident occurs weeks before a snap general election called by Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.
stories.why: The tragedy threatens confidence in Spain’s rail system and may influence voter sentiment ahead of the upcoming election.

stories.title: India's services trade surplus rises to $53.39 billion in Q2
stories.summary: The country received $113.029 billion under this head during the three months while it paid $59.637 billion, the data showed. September saw the biggest surplus at $19.208 billion while it was $17.647 billion and $16.537 billion in July and August respectively.
stories.why: This matters because it can affect economic growth, prices, employment, borrowing costs or trade decisions.

stories.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
stories.summary: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee billions in debt financing for AI cloud provider Nscale’s planned Anthropic data center in West Virginia, The Information reported Thursday . Anthropic’s contract with Nscale covers the first 460-megawatt building at Nscale’s West Virginia campus, which is expected to use Nvidia’s next-generation Vera Rubin chips.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.
stories.previousTitle: Nvidia in talks to co‑sign debt for Nscale’s West Virginia AI data center
stories.previousSummary: Nvidia is discussing a residual‑value guarantee that would co‑sign billions of dollars in debt financing for AI cloud provider Nscale’s planned Anthropic data center in West Virginia. Under the proposal, Nvidia would step in if Nscale defaults on construction payments, temporarily take over the facility and help find a buyer or new tenant. Anthropic has signed a $44.6 billion contract for the first 460‑MW building, and a second deal of roughly $45 billion is also being discussed.

stories.title: RBI deliberates economic risks at 625th Central Board meeting chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India conducted its 625th Central Board meeting under Governor Sanjay Malhotra. The board reviewed economic conditions and potential risks facing India’s economy while evaluating the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation’s activities.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: India’s FTAs to open access to $85 trillion market; Piyush Goyal urges exporters to go global
stories.summary: India's trade agreements are expected to provide exporters preferential access to markets with a combined GDP of $85 trillion, covering 76% of the global economy, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said. Piyush Goyal said India's expanding network of trade agreements will open access to an $85 trillion global market, urging domestic exporters to move beyond the home market and build global brands.
stories.why: This matters because it could affect India’s economy, major industries, investment, jobs or trade.
